HE STOLE HER HEART SO SHE STOLE HIS PAJAMAS!

Christian Nationalism's unholy war on Democracy.

They used the world's deadliest weapons against this super-secret agent!

43149: 4 friends of the Cult Gang are chosen as heroes in a film,but shooting stops due to financial issues.To save their dream,they do kidnapping for money and get trapped in risky trouble involving faction leader Rami Reddy.Will they survive?

Sooner or later, everything goes down.

It's the Book with a Heartful of Love that Thrilled Millions!

A Forbidden Love That Threatened Two Kingdoms!

The shocking novel excites the screen! There is only one!

Peter Lorre gives you your greatest thrill
